text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Thanks for the day off!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
By the way, do you have time right now?
I found
this awesome music video
yesterday.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I thought you might like it too. Can I
show you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити seems sufficiently refreshed.
She must
have been able to enjoy her
day off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
